notes: The permanent main chat now routes OSMINOG product edits directly to jeep-jim/OSMINOG through owner-confirmed GitHub tools. A unified Window Manager adds deterministic z-order, move/resize, a shared hover shelf and a top minimize tray. Module Store is now a master/detail surface without duplicate card actions; custom modules are removable, system modules are protected, and desktop shortcuts are independent. Widgets render without a redundant host container, desktop icons share one interaction model, node handles are consistent, web results can be embedded as real files, and transparent PNG/WebP/SVG bytes are preserved.
